page.overview:
Who is Badran Esparad?

was the captain of the Golden Scythe guild of Avalir. As an NPC, was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

As a part of his duties to the Golden Scythe, Captain Badran was responsible for transmitting a payment to the mercenary group the "Stormbringers", who had helped the guild on the coast of Issylra. He was told by the guildmaster Nydas Okiro to forestall their payment until just after the Replenishment, as the guild was experiencing a cash flow problem. Before this, the Captain had arranged a fireworks show for Nydas, involving the students of the Sorcerer's University.

When the growing chaos of the Calamity took over the streets of the city of Avalir, Badran, several sailor-marines of the Harvest Moon, Alessander Kyrus, and Daenyria barricaded themselves in the Vault of the Golden Scythe. When Guildmaster Nydas arrived, he conveyed to him a message from the Ring of Gold that required the ships of the guild at the top of the city to evacuate the wealthy and elite of Avalir. When Nydas refused, in favor of the more vulnerable populace, Badran and Alessander then suggested they take care of the gold in their vault. However, Nydas denied its value in the face of the global disaster and continued to insist on saving anyone they could, flying as far as they could from both Avalir and Vasselheim.

As soon as Nydas finished speaking and turned to deal with other matters, Badran, caring more about the guild's gold then people, stabbed him in the back, piercing through his stomach. In retribution, Nydas stabbed him three times in succession and let Sha'korzhan deal the final blow.
